upload.dropzone: Drag files here or click to browse
upload.hint.apk: Upload .apk packages. They are stored under the branch and repository (directory) below; the architecture comes from the package.
upload.apk.branchHint: Alpine release branch, for example v3.20 or edge.
upload.apk.repoHint: Directory inside the branch, for example main or community.
upload.apk.archHint: Only needed for noarch packages, for example x86_64. Leave empty otherwise.
upload.apk.invalid: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores; start with a letter or digit (up to 64 characters).
upload.hint.pacman: Upload .pkg.tar.zst, .pkg.tar.xz or .pkg.tar.gz packages and optional .sig signature files.
upload.pacman.archHint: Used for "any" packages and for files whose name carries no architecture.
pwa.updateHint: Reload to switch to it. Your current page is left untouched until you do.

graph.title: Dependency graph
settings.passwordDesc: Update your account password. Minimum 12 characters required.
docs.helpPage: Open the documentation for this page (new tab)
upload.nix.body: Nix binary caches are published with `nix copy --to`, authenticated with an API token in a netrc file. Nothing is uploaded from the browser:
upload.hint.raw: Upload any files. Each keeps its name and is stored in the directory below.
upload.raw.dirHint: Optional folder inside the repository, for example releases/1.0.
upload.raw.dirInvalid: Use folder names separated by slashes, without . or .. segments.
upload.hint.npm: Upload a .tgz tarball made by `npm pack`. The package name and version are read from its package.json.
upload.npm.tagHint: The tag that points at the published version.
upload.npm.tagInvalid: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores; it must not look like a version.
upload.hint.pypi: Upload wheels (.whl) or source distributions (.tar.gz, .zip). The name and version are read from the file name.
upload.hint.maven: Upload the .jar, .pom and other files of one version. Each file name must start with the artifact ID and version, joined by a dash.
upload.maven.versionHint: A release version, or a -SNAPSHOT version.
upload.hint.helm: Upload a chart package (.tgz) made by `helm package`.
upload.hint.rubygems: Upload a .gem file built by `gem build`.
upload.hint.ansible: Upload a collection tarball made by `ansible-galaxy collection build`. Its namespace, name and version are read from the archive.
upload.hint.conda: Upload .conda or .tar.bz2 packages for the platform below.
upload.conda.platformHint: The subdirectory the packages are published under, for example linux-64, osx-arm64 or noarch.
upload.hint.composer: Upload the dist zip of one version of the package below.
upload.composer.packageHint: Vendor and name, as in composer.json.
upload.composer.packageInvalid: Use a lowercase vendor/name, for example acme/widgets.
upload.hint.terraform: Upload a module archive (.tar.gz or .zip) or a provider zip named terraform-provider-TYPE_VERSION_OS_ARCH.zip.
upload.terraform.name: Module name
upload.terraform.systemHint: The system the module is written for, for example aws.
upload.terraform.versionInvalid: Use a semantic version such as 1.2.3 or 1.2.3-rc.1.
upload.hint.go: Upload a module zip, as made by `go mod download` or golang.org/x/mod/zip. The module path and version are read from the archive.
upload.error.npmManifest: No package.json found in the tarball. Upload the .tgz that `npm pack` produces.
upload.error.pypiName: Cannot read a package name and version from this file name. Use a wheel or a source archive named name-version.
upload.error.mavenName: The file name must start with the artifact ID and the version, joined by a dash.
upload.error.goModule: Not a Go module zip: its files must be under module@version/.
upload.error.terraformProvider: A provider zip must be named terraform-provider-TYPE_VERSION_OS_ARCH.zip.
